title: The 8 Levels of Bridesmaid Budgets
house: A bustling metropolitan city populated entirely by produce people, featuring neon-lit skyscrapers, a central subway line with a shiny golden coin hidden behind every ticket kiosk, and a trendy rooftop café where everyone judges your digital forehead display.
catchphrase: The glowing digit on your forehead never lies.

levels.name: Mia, 23, Intern
levels.story: The 8 levels of bridesmaid budgets. Level 1. How can you afford the bachelorette trip to Miami with only one hundred fifty dollars in your bank account? One hundred fifty dollars? Who invited this pathetic little strawberry to our luxury group chat? Maybe she can clean the yacht toilets for us rich bridesmaids instead of posing in the photos. We are invited as VIP guests, so treat us with absolute respect. The number on my forehead is my monthly grocery money, not my self-worth. You are standing in a five-star hotel lobby wearing a thrift store dress that smells like mothballs. Then she looked straight into my eyes and whispered the sentence that completely destroyed my pride. You will never survive this trip without begging on the street. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Chloe, 26, Barista
levels.story: The 8 levels of bridesmaid budgets. Level 2. Eight hundred fifty dollars a month is all I earn pouring artisanal oat milk lattes at the downtown station café. You call this an affordable bachelorette trip when my entire monthly rent is eight hundred dollars? Everyone stared at my glowing forehead display while I handed over my meager contribution envelope. She laughed in my face and told me that my pocket change wouldn't even buy the champagne ice cubes. You are dragging us down into financial ruin just for your Instagram aesthetic. Then she slammed the itemized spreadsheet onto the marble table and uttered the cold truth. If you cannot afford the yacht charter, you do not deserve to stand at my altar. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Leo, 29, Accountant
levels.story: The 8 levels of bridesmaid budgets. Level 3. Two thousand four hundred dollars a month as a junior tax accountant does not cover three bachelorette weekend trips across the country. My forehead display glows with quiet mediocrity while the other groomsmen flash five-figure luxury numbers. Why should I take out a bank loan just to buy custom golf clubs for a bachelor party in Las Vegas? You are living way beyond your means and dragging your friends into debt. He smirked at my calculator and called me a penniless bean counter who belongs in the cheap seats. I balanced every single receipt for this wedding, and you still accuse me of stealing from the common pool. We are drowning in expenses because you demanded helicopter tours and private cabanas. Then the best man stepped forward and dropped a bombshell sentence that silenced the entire room. You will be paying off this weekend until your hair turns grey. You'll see that in Level 4.

levels.name: Maya, 27, Graphic Designer
levels.story: The 8 levels of bridesmaid budgets. Level 4. Four thousand one hundred dollars a month as a freelance designer should be enough to enjoy being a bridesmaid without going bankrupt. But my custom bridal shower gift contribution was mocked for not being expensive enough. You think buying a thousand-dollar crystal vase proves friendship? My forehead display is glowing with honest wages, not crypto scams or inherited wealth. She sneered at my handmade invitation designs and called them amateur dollar-store garbage. I spent three sleepless nights designing your custom wedding logo for free, and this is how you repay me? We are here to celebrate love, not to compete in a wealth pageant funded by maxed-out credit cards. Then she tossed my sketchbook into the decorative fountain and uttered the ultimate insult. Your little drawings are worth less than the paper they are printed on. You'll see that in Level 5.

levels.name: Oliver, 31, Architect
levels.story: The 8 levels of bridesmaid budgets. Level 5. Six thousand eight hundred dollars a month designing luxury suburban homes should buy me some peace during this chaotic wedding planning. But the bride expects every groomsman to pay two thousand dollars for custom tailored suits we will wear exactly once. You call this honoring our friendship when you treat us like walking ATM machines? My forehead display is shining bright with professional success, yet I am being treated like a freeloader. He scoffed at my architectural blueprints and told me my building designs looked like shoeboxes. I am funding half of this bachelor trip out of my own savings while you take all the credit on social media. We are adults with real mortgages, not teenagers playing billionaire dress-up. Then he crossed his arms and delivered the most arrogant verdict of the evening. If you cannot afford a custom Italian suit, you do not belong in my photos. You'll see that in Level 6.

levels.name: Victoria, 29, Event Planner
levels.story: The 8 levels of bridesmaid budgets. Level 6. Twelve thousand five hundred dollars a month running the top luxury event planning firm in the city, yet I am expected to cater to ungrateful bridesmaids. You think organizing a destination wedding in Santorini is easy when everyone complains about luxury accommodation costs? My forehead display shines with pure executive excellence, while they whine about hundred-dollar boat tours. She dared to question my vendor commission rates right in front of the bride and groom. I have spent six months turning your mediocre vision into a fairytale wedding, and you accuse me of overcharging? We are talking about luxury standards, not a backyard barbecue with paper plates. Then she sneered at my designer clipboard and dropped the most disrespectful line of the season. Your luxury event planning looks like a glorified birthday party for toddlers. You'll see that in Level 7.

levels.name: Amber, 32, Bride
levels.story: The 8 levels of bridesmaid budgets. Level 7. Eighteen thousand dollars a month funding my dream wedding, yet my bridesmaids act like ungrateful peasants whining about expenses. You expect me to downgrade my fairytale reception just because your forehead display only shows pocket change? My forehead shines with undisputed queen status while you try to sabotage my special day. She had the audacity to complain about buying a three-hundred-dollar bridesmaid dress on her meager barista salary. I gave you the honor of standing next to me at the altar, and you repay me by spreading rumors about my wedding debt? We are creating memories that will last forever, not balancing a cheap grocery budget. Then she glared at my diamond tiara and spat out the most venomous insult imaginable. You are buying your happiness with borrowed money that will ruin you by next year. You'll see that in Level 8.

levels.name: Maximilian, 35, Tycoon
levels.story: The 8 levels of bridesmaid budgets. Level 8. Twenty-five thousand dollars passive income every single week while financing every single wedding in this produce city. My forehead display glows with absolute power, yet people still argue over pathetic bridesmaid budgets. Why are you all fighting over who pays for a yacht trip when I bought the entire marina? You call yourselves rich with four-figure numbers while real wealth remains entirely silent. He tried to audit my wedding accounts and accused me of financial fraud in front of everyone. I paid off every single debt for every single person in this bridal party just to watch them squirm. You think your little status games mean anything in a world where numbers can be changed with one keystroke? Then I turned around and whispered the final sentence that shattered the entire status illusion forever. The number on your forehead was never yours to begin with; it was just rented time. Which topic should we destroy next in our series?
